title: Date Picker cells render MM/DD/YYYY while the inspector says the format is DD/MM/YYYY
combination: Date Picker column whose definition has no stored `dateFormat` (dynamic columns via Column data, imported/older apps, programmatic column definitions)
steps: Table on a blank canvas. Inspector → **Data**, paste:
Properties → turn on **Use dynamic column** and set **Column data** to `{{[{name: "c", key: "c", columnType: "datepicker"}]}}` (any Date Picker column without a saved Date format reproduces it).
Look at the cell, then open the column in **Table Columns** and read **Date format**.
expected: The cell shows `15/03/2024`, matching the Date format the inspector displays (and the documented default `DD/MM/YYYY`).
actual: The cell shows `03/15/2024`. With **Show time** on it shows `03/15/2024 1:30 PM`; with 24-hour on, `03/15/2024 13:30`. The inspector meanwhile shows DD/MM/YYYY, so the builder cannot see why.
evidence: expected "03/15/2024" to equal "15/03/2024" (A2-datepicker.cy.js, 3 tests)
note: **Root cause:** the renderer and the inspector fall back to different defaults when `dateFormat` is undefined. Columns created through the inspector get `DD/MM/YYYY` written by useColumnManager.js:51, which is why it hides; every other way of defining a column hits the renderer default. The dynamic-column path in step 2 is inferred from the same fallback; the run used an explicit column definition without dateFormat.

actual: The cell shows the placeholder text `Select..` in all four cases: a value not in the options, an array on a single Select, and null or an empty array on MultiSelect. Data the options do not cover is silently hidden behind a prompt that suggests the cell is editable.
evidence: expected "Select.." to equal "" (A2-select-multiselect-tags.cy.js, 4 tests)
